state.faq_question: What is the refund window for annual plans?
state.verified_answer: Annual plans can be refunded in full within 30 days of purchase. After 30 days, refunds are prorated for the unused months.

passages.p2: Annual plans are non-refundable once activated; only monthly plans can be cancelled for a refund.
passages.p3: You can upgrade from a monthly to an annual plan at any time from the billing settings page.
